issues.statement: Deciding whether to quantize when the model already fits in VRAM at full precision
issues.source_fix: Only quantize when it genuinely doesn't fit; otherwise load full precision — quantization adds overhead and can cost quality for nothing
issues.quote: quantization adds dequantization overhead and can cost quality for no benefit when memory isn't the constraint

issues.statement: Deciding whether to shard across GPUs when the model fits on one GPU
issues.source_fix: Keep the single-GPU path unless the model is too large for one GPU; parallelism only adds comms overhead when it already fits
issues.quote: parallelism adds cross-GPU communication overhead that buys nothing when the model already fits

issues.statement: Which quantization method to pick given the GPU generation and checkpoint availability
issues.source_fix: FP8 on Hopper+/Ada; pre-quantized AWQ/GPTQ INT4 for broad GPUs; BitsAndBytes for on-the-fly; GGUF for CPU/edge
issues.quote: FP8 on Hopper+/Ada (fastest, minimal quality loss); pre-quantized AWQ/GPTQ (INT4) for broad GPU support

issues.statement: Whether to run a persistent server or a one-shot in-process batch job
issues.source_fix: Use vllm serve for a persistent API from app code/multiple clients; the offline LLM class for a single-script batch job
issues.quote: Online serving (`vllm serve`) for a persistent API; the offline `LLM` class for a one-shot batch job in a single script

issues.statement: When to use tensor parallelism vs pipeline parallelism
issues.source_fix: Use tensor parallelism within a single node; add pipeline parallelism only to span multiple nodes
issues.quote: Tensor parallelism within a single node (fast NVLink/PCIe); add pipeline parallelism only to span multiple nodes

issues.statement: How to cut single-stream decode latency
issues.source_fix: Enable speculative decoding (draft model / n-gram / EAGLE); otherwise keep default scheduling
issues.quote: Enable speculative decoding (draft model / n-gram / EAGLE) to cut per-step latency; otherwise keep default scheduling

issues.statement: Model still OOMs even after enabling quantization
issues.source_fix: Lower --gpu-memory-utilization / --max-model-len
issues.quote: Lower `--gpu-memory-utilization` / `--max-model-len` if it still OOMs

issues.statement: Catching an OOM before the engine/server even starts loading weights
issues.source_fix: Probe free VRAM before launching vllm serve or instantiating LLM (scripts/check_vram.sh)
issues.quote: before launching `vllm serve` or instantiating `LLM`, to catch OOM early

issues.statement: Old V0 engine path / V0-only flags no longer work as expected
issues.source_fix: Use the V1 engine (now default, VLLM_USE_V1=1); V0-specific flags are no-ops
issues.quote: use the V1 engine, now the default (`VLLM_USE_V1=1`). V0-specific flags are no-ops.

issues.statement: Trying to compute gradient updates / train LoRA adapters with vLLM
issues.source_fix: Use a trainer (transformers Trainer, peft, trl) to train, then load the result into vLLM to serve/evaluate
issues.quote: For computing gradient updates / fine-tuning the weights themselves (including training LoRA adapters), use a trainer

issues.statement: Needing to free more VRAM beyond weight quantization
issues.source_fix: Optionally enable a quantized KV cache to free more VRAM
issues.quote: Optionally enable a quantized KV cache to free more VRAM

issues.statement: Sending requests before the server has finished loading the model
issues.source_fix: Wait for /health to report healthy (and confirm GET /v1/models) before the first request
issues.quote: Wait for the server to report healthy on `/health`

issues.statement: Serving across multiple nodes
issues.source_fix: Launch a Ray cluster first, then serve across it
issues.quote: For multi-node, launch a Ray cluster first, then serve across it

issues.statement: Loading a LoRA adapter whose rank exceeds the engine's configured max
issues.source_fix: Set max_lora_rank >= the rank of any adapter you load
issues.quote: must be >= the rank of any adapter you load

issues.statement: LoRA adapter cache keyed on the request's int_id
issues.source_fix: Give each LoRARequest a unique, stable int_id per adapter
issues.quote: `int_id` must be unique and stable per adapter; vLLM keys its adapter cache on it.

issues.statement: Selecting a registered LoRA adapter on the online server
issues.source_fix: Put the adapter's name in the request's model field
issues.quote: select one by using its **name as the model field** in the request.

issues.statement: Loading/unloading LoRA adapters at runtime without restart
issues.source_fix: Start the server with VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING=True, then call load/unload endpoints
issues.quote: VLLM_ALLOW_RUNTIME_LORA_UPDATING=True vllm serve meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf --enable-lora

issues.statement: Choosing a draft model for speculative decoding
issues.source_fix: The draft model must share a tokenizer/vocabulary with the target model
issues.quote: The draft model must share a tokenizer/vocabulary with the target model.

issues.statement: Worry that speculative decoding changes generation quality
issues.source_fix: Output is identical to non-speculative greedy decoding — it's a latency optimization only
issues.quote: Output text is **identical** to non-speculative greedy decoding — this is a latency optimization, not a quality change.

issues.statement: Speculative decoding gives little/no speedup
issues.source_fix: Sweep num_speculative_tokens (3–7); gains fall off when draft proposals are frequently rejected
issues.quote: sweep `num_speculative_tokens` (3–7) and measure tokens/sec; gains fall off when the draft's proposals are frequently rejected.

issues.statement: Picking a speculative method for summarization/RAG where output echoes input
issues.source_fix: Try ngram speculation first — no draft weights needed and often the biggest win for input-heavy tasks
issues.quote: for input-heavy tasks (long-doc summarization), try `ngram` first — it's free to enable and often the biggest win.

issues.statement: Producing JSON/regex/choice/grammar-constrained output offline
issues.source_fix: Attach a GuidedDecodingParams spec to SamplingParams
issues.quote: attach a guided-decoding spec to `SamplingParams`.

issues.statement: Re-instantiating LLM per batch reloads weights and reallocates KV cache
issues.source_fix: Construct LLM once and reuse it for every batch
issues.quote: Construct it a single time and reuse it for every batch — re-instantiating reloads weights and re-allocates the KV cache.

issues.statement: Model ships custom modeling code and fails to load
issues.source_fix: Pass trust_remote_code for models that ship custom modeling code
issues.quote: `trust_remote_code` — required for models that ship custom modeling code.

issues.statement: KV cache too large to fit at the model's full context length (offline LLM)
issues.source_fix: Cap max_model_len to fit a smaller KV cache
issues.quote: `max_model_len` — cap the context length to fit a smaller KV cache.

issues.statement: Getting deterministic/greedy decoding
issues.source_fix: Set temperature=0
issues.quote: For greedy decoding, set `temperature=0`.

issues.statement: Passing precomputed prompt_embeds fails unless enabled at construction
issues.source_fix: Create the engine with enable_prompt_embeds=True
issues.quote: The engine must be created with `enable_prompt_embeds=True`

issues.statement: Slow generation from looping over prompts one at a time
issues.source_fix: Submit all prompts at once so vLLM batches them with continuous batching
issues.quote: submitting many prompts at once is far faster than looping one at a time.

issues.statement: Progress bar noise in scripted/automated runs
issues.source_fix: Pass use_tqdm=False to silence the progress bar
issues.quote: Use `use_tqdm=False` to silence the progress bar in scripted runs.

issues.statement: Hand-formatting prompts for instruction-tuned/chat models
issues.source_fix: Use chat() so the model's chat template is applied instead of hand-formatting
issues.quote: use it for instruction-tuned / chat models instead of hand-formatting the prompt string.

issues.statement: Mismatch between image placeholder tokens and number of media items
issues.source_fix: The placeholder token in prompt must match the number of media items provided
issues.quote: The placeholder token in `prompt` must match the number of media items provided.

issues.statement: Sampling multiple candidates per prompt
issues.source_fix: Set n>1 and read all of output.outputs
issues.quote: For sampling several candidates, set `n>1` and read all of `output.outputs`.

issues.statement: KV-cache allocation OOMs at server startup
issues.source_fix: Lower --max-model-len to shrink the KV cache
issues.quote: `--max-model-len` caps the context window (lower it if KV-cache allocation OOMs)

issues.statement: Clients must repeat the full HF id in every request
issues.source_fix: Set --served-model-name to a short alias
issues.quote: Set it to a short alias so requests don't have to repeat the full HF id.

issues.statement: Serving a model whose tokenizer has no chat template
issues.source_fix: Provide --chat-template (path or inline Jinja) when the tokenizer has none
issues.quote: `--chat-template` — path to (or inline) a Jinja chat template, needed when a model's tokenizer has none.

issues.statement: /v1/embeddings not available
issues.source_fix: Start the server as a pooling/embedding model with --task embed
issues.quote: `/v1/embeddings` is only served when the loaded model is run as a pooling/embedding model.

issues.statement: Choosing between /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions
issues.source_fix: Use /v1/completions for base (non-chat) models or to control the exact prompt string
issues.quote: Use this endpoint for base (non-chat) models or when you want to control the exact prompt string yourself.

issues.statement: OpenAI client requires an api_key against a keyless local server
issues.source_fix: Pass any placeholder (e.g. "EMPTY") when no --api-key is set; it is ignored
issues.quote: When no `--api-key` is set, pass any placeholder (e.g. `"EMPTY"`) for `api_key` — it is ignored.

issues.statement: Trading throughput against per-request latency
issues.source_fix: Tune --max-num-seqs (max concurrent sequences in a batch)
issues.quote: `--max-num-seqs` — max concurrent sequences in a batch (throughput vs. per-request latency lever).

issues.statement: Sizing TP and PP for a distributed deployment
issues.source_fix: Set tensor_parallel_size = GPUs per node, pipeline_parallel_size = number of nodes
issues.quote: set `tensor_parallel_size` to the number of GPUs **per node**, and `pipeline_parallel_size` to the number of **nodes**.

issues.statement: Which parallelism axis to use for a given goal (fit vs throughput vs MoE)
issues.source_fix: TP shards within a layer to fit / free KV cache; PP splits layers for very large models; DP replicates for throughput; EP for MoE experts
issues.quote: TP shards parameters *within* a layer to fit a model / free KV-cache room; PP splits *layers* across GPUs for very large models

issues.statement: Selecting physical GPUs; setting device index before vLLM init corrupts setup
issues.source_fix: Use CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; do NOT call torch.accelerator.set_device_index() before vLLM initializes
issues.quote: set `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` — do **not** call `torch.accelerator.set_device_index()` before vLLM initializes.

issues.statement: Misreading --max-num-seqs as a global cap under data parallelism
issues.source_fix: Note --max-num-seqs applies per DP rank, so total throughput scales with deployment size
issues.quote: `--max-num-seqs` applies **per DP rank**, so total throughput scales with deployment size.

issues.statement: Data-parallel multi-node deployment with the Ray backend
issues.source_fix: Set VLLM_RAY_DP_PACK_STRATEGY="span" for multi-node Ray-backend DP
issues.quote: set `VLLM_RAY_DP_PACK_STRATEGY="span"` for multi-node

issues.statement: Single API server becomes a bottleneck at large DP sizes
issues.source_fix: Scale with --api-server-count or switch to hybrid load balancing
issues.quote: At larger DP sizes the single API server becomes a bottleneck — scale it with `--api-server-count`

issues.statement: Serving a MoE model efficiently
issues.source_fix: Enable expert parallelism (enable_expert_parallel / --enable-expert-parallel) to use EP instead of TP for MoE layers
issues.quote: Enable with `enable_expert_parallel=True` (Python) or `--enable-expert-parallel` (CLI) — this uses EP instead of TP for MoE layers.

issues.statement: Selecting a DeepEP all-to-all backend
issues.source_fix: Install DeepEP/DeepGEMM first before using those backends
issues.quote: DeepEP/DeepGEMM must be installed first.

issues.statement: Uneven token distribution across MoE experts
issues.source_fix: Enable the Expert Parallel Load Balancer with --enable-eplb
issues.quote: Rebalances token distribution across experts. Enable with `--enable-eplb`

issues.statement: Choosing weight-only 4-bit vs weight+activation 8-bit quantization
issues.source_fix: Use 4-bit (AWQ/GPTQ/W4A16) when VRAM-bound; 8-bit (FP8/INT8 W8A8) when throughput-bound with tensor-core support
issues.quote: the best fit when you are **VRAM-bound** and want to fit a larger model on one card

issues.statement: Reaching for quantization before confirming full precision doesn't fit
issues.source_fix: Only quantize after full precision doesn't fit — quantization always costs some accuracy
issues.quote: Reach for these only after the model in full precision does not fit — quantization always costs some accuracy.

issues.statement: Whether to pass quantization= for a pre-quantized Hub checkpoint
issues.source_fix: vLLM auto-detects the format from the checkpoint config; you don't need to pass quantization at all
issues.quote: vLLM auto-detects the format from the checkpoint config and you do not need to pass `quantization` at all

issues.statement: Confirming which quantization kernel actually got selected
issues.source_fix: Read the startup log line that reports the quantization method
issues.quote: confirm the kernel actually selected by reading the startup log line that reports the quantization method.

issues.statement: Expecting peak throughput from AWQ
issues.source_fix: AWQ is under-optimized vs FP8/INT8 — prefer it for VRAM savings, not peak throughput
issues.quote: AWQ in vLLM is described as under-optimized vs FP8/INT8 — prefer it for VRAM savings, not peak throughput.

issues.statement: Using FP8 on a GPU without FP8 tensor cores
issues.source_fix: FP8 requires a GPU with FP8 tensor cores (compute capability 8.9+/Hopper)
issues.quote: FP8 requires a GPU with FP8 tensor cores (compute capability 8.9+/Hopper).

issues.statement: Dynamic (load-time) FP8 vs offline-calibrated FP8 checkpoint
issues.source_fix: Dynamic FP8 has a small accuracy cost; for production prefer an offline FP8 checkpoint from LLM Compressor
issues.quote: dynamic FP8 may have a small accuracy cost vs an offline-calibrated checkpoint, so for production prefer an offline FP8 checkpoint

issues.statement: Loading a BitsAndBytes model requires both quantization and load_format flags
issues.source_fix: Pass --quantization bitsandbytes AND --load-format bitsandbytes
issues.quote: vllm serve huggyllama/llama-7b --quantization bitsandbytes --load-format bitsandbytes

issues.statement: BitsAndBytes is slower at serve time despite quick fit
issues.source_fix: Use bnb for a quick fit when serve speed is secondary; re-quantize to AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 if throughput matters
issues.quote: Use this when you need a quick fit on a small card and serve-time speed is secondary.

issues.statement: GGUF file loads without a usable tokenizer
issues.source_fix: Supply the matching HF tokenizer — GGUF files don't carry a vLLM-compatible tokenizer
issues.quote: supply the matching HF tokenizer (GGUF files do not carry a vLLM-compatible tokenizer)

issues.statement: Model split into multiple GGUF shards
issues.source_fix: Merge shards with gguf-split --merge first, then pass the single merged file
issues.quote: merge them with `gguf-split --merge` first, then pass the single merged file.

issues.statement: Relying on GGUF for a production path
issues.source_fix: Treat GGUF support as experimental and verify generations look sane
issues.quote: GGUF support is experimental.

issues.statement: Self-quantizing a model with GPTQ
issues.source_fix: Use GPTQModel, which needs calibration data
issues.quote: Quantize with GPTQModel, which needs calibration data
